builds.title: Hedgerow observer, Monk 1
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +2, Dexterity save +4. AC 14 is 10 + Dexterity 2 + Wisdom 2. HP 10 is 8 + Constitution 2.
Hermit supplies Medicine, Religion, Sylvan, and Discovery. Monk supplies Acrobatics and Insight. Tanglebud uses no equipment in combat.
False Appearance. Stay motionless and concentrate for 1 minute. While motionless afterward Tanglebud looks like a mundane shrub. Vulnerable to fire damage.
actions: Rake. Dexterity-based unarmed strike. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+2 slashing.
Martial Arts. After an Attack action with Rake, make one conventional root bump as a bonus action. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d4+2 bludgeoning.
builds.tactics: Tanglebud waits at a bend in the hedge, calls out to strangers first, and rakes anyone who rushes past its roots.

builds.title: Fast ridge courier, Barbarian 2
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +5, Constitution save +4. AC 14 is 10 + Dexterity 2 + Constitution 2. HP is 14 + 9.
Outlander supplies Athletics, Survival, Dwarvish, and Wanderer. Barbarian supplies Animal Handling and Perception. Cleftbill wears no armor and wields no gear.
Danger Sense. Gain advantage on Dexterity saves against visible effects while free of the blinded, deafened, and incapacitated conditions.
actions: Bite. Strength-based unarmed strike. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d8+3 slashing, or 1d8+5 while raging.

Rage. Bonus action twice per long rest. For up to 1 minute, gain advantage on Strength checks and saves, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, and +2 to Strength-based melee weapon attack damage, including Strength-based unarmed strikes. Rage ends early when knocked unconscious or if the turn ends without an attack on a hostile creature or damage taken since the last turn.
Reckless Attack. On the first attack of the turn, choose advantage on Strength-based melee weapon attacks that turn. Attacks against Cleftbill have advantage until its next turn.
builds.tactics: Cleftbill warns travelers away from a broken ledge. It uses its speed to intercept pursuers and bites if they block the way.

builds.title: Waystation scout, Monk 2
builds.senses: Passive Perception 14, or 19 when hearing or smell applies.
builds.languages: Speaks, reads, and writes Blink Dog. Understands, reads, and writes Sylvan.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +2, Dexterity save +5. AC 15 is 10 + Dexterity 3 + Wisdom 2. HP is 10 + 7. Monk movement adds 10 ft. to the printed walking speed.
Sailor supplies Athletics, Perception, and Ship’s Passage. Monk supplies Acrobatics and Insight. Latch wears a plain neck cloth and carries no combat equipment.
Keen Hearing and Smell. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on hearing or smell. Ki pool 2, regained on a short or long rest with at least 30 minutes of meditation.
actions: Bite. Dexterity-based unarmed strike. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+3 piercing.
Martial Arts. After Bite as an Attack action, make one shoulder bump as a bonus action. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d4+3 bludgeoning.
Flurry of Blows. After the Attack action, spend 1 ki and a bonus action to make two conventional shoulder bumps. Each is +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d4+3 bludgeoning.
Patient Defense. Spend 1 ki and a bonus action to Dodge. Step of the Wind. Spend 1 ki and a bonus action to Disengage or Dash, with double jump distance that turn.
Teleport. Bonus action to move with carried or worn gear to a visible unoccupied space within 40 ft. One use per short or long rest.
builds.tactics: Latch hears out travelers and circles behind anyone closing on the stranded. It saves Teleport for a blocked route or a quick retreat.

builds.title: Gatehouse sentry, Fighter 2
builds.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 12, or 17 while both heads are awake.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength and Constitution saves +5. AC 12 is 10 + Dexterity 2. HP is 13 + 9.
Soldier supplies Athletics, Intimidation, and Military Rank. Fighter supplies Perception and Survival. Defense is the chosen fighting style and gives no AC bonus while unarmored.
Two Heads. While both heads are awake, advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and saves against becoming blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.
actions: Bite. Strength-based unarmed strike. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+3 piercing.
Second Wind. Bonus action to regain 1d10+2 HP. One use per short or long rest.
Action Surge. On its turn take one additional action, which can be a second Attack action for another Bite. One use per short or long rest.
builds.tactics: One head challenges trespassers while the other listens. The hound uses Action Surge only when a foe rushes past it toward the gate.

builds.title: Tunnel lamplight, Barbarian 1
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +4, Constitution save +5. Natural AC 15 is 13 + Dexterity 2. Unarmored Defense also gives 15, from 10 + Dexterity 2 + Constitution 3. HP is 12 + 3.
Soldier supplies Athletics, Intimidation, and Military Rank. Barbarian supplies Perception and Survival. Wick carries no tools or gear.
Illumination. Wick sheds bright light for 10 ft., then dim light for another 10 ft.
actions: Bite. Strength-based unarmed strike. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6+2 slashing, or 1d6+4 while raging.

Rage. Bonus action twice per long rest. For up to 1 minute, gain advantage on Strength checks and saves, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, and +2 to Strength-based melee weapon attack damage, including Strength-based unarmed strikes. Rage ends early when knocked unconscious or if the turn ends without an attack on a hostile creature or damage taken since the last turn.
builds.tactics: Wick stays near the floor and lights the low route for the crew. It rages and blocks the passage if the crew needs time to retreat.

concepts.name: Tanglebud
concepts.role: A hawthorn shrub that watches a boundary path.
concepts.motive: Find the apprentice who last pruned its hedge.
concepts.hook: A voice from the hedge describes fresh footprints heading into a shuttered orchard.

concepts.name: Cleftbill
concepts.role: An awakened runner that carries messages along the ridge.
concepts.motive: Get a search crew across the ridge before dusk.
concepts.hook: Cleftbill asks the party to warn the crew away from the ledge it saw crumble.

concepts.name: Latch
concepts.role: A fey scout that patrols an overgrown waystation.
concepts.motive: Get stranded travelers off a road that shifts at dusk.
concepts.hook: Latch blinks to the far side of a barricade, leaves a trail of paw marks, and waits for the party.

concepts.name: Marl and Soot
concepts.role: One two-headed hound that guards a deserted gatehouse.
concepts.motive: Find out why the gate’s relief crew failed to arrive.
concepts.hook: One head asks for the password while the other whispers that the relief crew never showed.

concepts.name: Wick
concepts.role: An awakened beetle that lights old quarry tunnels.
concepts.motive: Retrieve the stone marker that shows the safe way out.
concepts.hook: An amber glow moves behind the rubble, and Wick calls for help recovering its marker.
